Collectible ≠ guaranteed return

The investment desk is an asking-price snapshot, not a resale forecast. Each listing names its comparison source and shows condition and completeness where the scan confirmed them.

Price integrityThe Rolex Explorer 124270 and Rolex Submariner Date 126610LN use the live Chrono24 professional-dealer references named on their cards. Both are watch-only, with no original box or papers; the Submariner is visibly worn, lightly polished, and short two links. Neither asking-price spread promises appreciation.
LiquidityEstimate how broad the resale market is and how quickly similar pieces actually move.
CompletenessBox, papers, original parts and service records can matter disproportionately.
Ownership dragBuyer premium, tax, servicing, insurance and selling fees belong in the thesis.

Market data, not financial advice. No appreciation claims. Watches are illiquid collectibles; values can fall, provenance can be wrong, and servicing can erase an apparent discount.

Notes on the register

01 / DEAL PRICE

Merchant listing

The displayed deal price was verified on the merchant product page on Sunday, October 11, 2026 · Morning (AM issue). Coupon, cash/wire, shipping, seller, and condition details are shown where they affect the effective price.

02 / REFERENCE

Street-price check

Reference prices come from the named comparable source. Some references use current live listings rather than completed sales because eBay’s sold-listings view was sign-in walled.

03 / OPEN QUESTIONS

Verify before buying

Availability, auction bids, checkout pricing, seller terms, warranty coverage, exact condition, and expiring coupon terms can change after the morning scan.

Liquidity, defined. Each watch carries the Ledger's liquidity read — High: deep resale market, typically sells in days at market price; Good: active market, typically sells in weeks at a fair price; Thin: narrow buyer pool, longer to sell. It's an editorial assessment from comparable listings, price band, and condition — a guide to how fast you could get out, not a resale guarantee.
